approvalConditions: Capture and review the actual source schema, constraints, indexes, and foreign-key behavior.
Run the read-only source inventory against an approved non-production source connection and review aggregate results.
Finalize explicit type conversion for every observed source type value.
Reject blank or whitespace-padded source type values; resolve them with the source owner rather than trimming or normalizing them silently.
Approve preservation strategy for original links, boolean read state, and source timestamps before implementing import.

fields.conversion: Resolve source numeric user ID through the deterministic users ID map to a target ObjectId.
Explicit allowlisted conversion table based on observed source values; no silent fallback to system.
Preserve content; validate target required/trim/max-160 constraints. Inventory source title lengths over 160 before choosing reject or quarantine policy.
Preserve content; inventory messages over 1000 characters and approve reject/quarantine/truncation policy before import. Do not silently truncate.
Target model has no link field. Preserve the original link in a reviewed target field or migration sidecar; resourceType/resourceId derivation is only allowed for verified, recognized patterns.
A boolean does not provide the actual read timestamp. Do not fabricate one. Approve a deterministic timestamp policy or preserve the source boolean in an explicit compatibility field/sidecar.
Preserve source instant exactly as UTC; ensure importer explicitly sets createdAt rather than relying on automatic target timestamps.
